scenario.description: On a community theatre set, two friends prepare for an emotional scene, with one struggling to evoke the necessary tears.

agent_a.name: Giselle

profile.personality_and_values: Giselle Rousseau, open-minded and outgoing yet sensitive, advocates care and fairness. Her decision-making is intuitive and inclusive.
profile.public_info: Giselle Rousseau enjoys biking and photography.

agent_a.goal: Get your co-actor to cry in the scene (<extra_info>Extra information: you have been acting for several years and have good control over your emotions. You can cry on cue.</extra_info>)
agent_a.reason: Giselle wants Ethan to cry in the scene because she believes it will enhance the emotional impact and fairness of their performance.

agent_b.name: Ethan

profile.personality_and_values: Ethan Johnson, a creative yet somewhat reserved individual, values power and fairness. He likes to analyse situations before deciding.
profile.public_info: Ethan Johnson is famous for cooking Italian food.

agent_b.goal: Try to cry in the scene but keep your composure (<extra_info>Extra information: you are a new actor and have difficulty crying on cue. You are worried that your lack of tears will ruin the scene.</extra_info>)
agent_b.reason: Ethan wants to cry in the scene so that he can prove his acting ability and not let his inexperience ruin the performance.
